facts.fact: The National Digital Development Agency (ANADEN) says Law 21-012/AU, promulgated by decree 22/003/PR, names the national agency as the competent cybersecurity authority and sits within a national cybersecurity strategy.
ANADEN says Law 21-012/AU on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime was adopted and promulgated by decree 22/003/PR.
ANADEN says the Comoros is part of the Africa Cybersecurity Authority advisory body (ANCA) within the Smart Africa Alliance.

COM.note: Awareness portal only; nothing on secondary schools.
